description: This source file defines a React context for authentication, including state management, API interactions for login, logout, and registration, and handles session expiration events.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: A React functional component that provides authentication context to child components, managing user state, tokens, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: fetchUser()
methods.description: Fetches current user data from API or local storage, sets user state, and handles token management.

methods.name: handleLogout()
methods.description: Handles logging out the user by clearing tokens, user data, and local storage; invoked on session expiration.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login via API, stores token, updates user state, and manages local storage.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing authentication tokens and user state.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user via API and optionally logs in after registration.
